entities.name: SN2 piperazine N-alkylation
observations: A primary 3-chloropropyl oxazolidinone undergoes substitution by the free secondary nitrogen of a piperazine bearing an electron-poor azaheteroaryl group.
The C–Cl bond is replaced by a propyl C–N(piperazine) bond; oxazolidinone and azaheteroarene frameworks remain unchanged.

entities.name: 3-chloropropyl oxazolidinone
observations: Primary alkyl chloride electrophile represented as O=C1OC(CCCCl)CN1Ph or equivalent normalized structure.

entities.name: azaaryl piperazine
observations: Piperazine-substituted azaheteroaromatic amine; the remaining secondary piperazine nitrogen is the principal nucleophile.

entities.name: carbonate iodide alkylation conditions
observations: Matched records support carbonate base, often potassium carbonate or related carbonate salts, with iodide such as KI or NaI; 1-butanol was listed in retrieved records.
Plausible alternatives include Cs2CO3 and polar aprotic solvents such as DMF, DMSO, or acetonitrile at approximately 50–90 °C.
